notes: The second his (t011) is added: וּמִכְנְסֵי בַד carries no suffix, unlike מִדּוֹ in the first clause.
Both בַד tokens are rendered attributively as linen, followed rather than recast with of under rule 28.
Rule 25's distributed-function-word clause was considered for the second his and rejected: the two clauses each have their own verb, so rule 18's closing sentence governs and the word is added.
